subject: Sneakpeek: Partner webinar promo code pool — confirmation and delivery plan
messages:
From: Olivia Park <olivia@brightfoundry.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: 200 guest codes for ‘Sneakpeek’ partner webinar

Hi Vanessa,

Hope you’re well — BrightFoundry is co-hosting a closed ‘Sneakpeek’ webinar on June 2 and we’d love to offer attendees a trial boost to try Redwood Inference features mentioned in the session. Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide 200 single-use promo codes (trial extension + 45 days of free trial credits) that we can distribute to registrants? Our ask:

- 200 unique promo codes in a single batch file (CSV or TXT)
- Trial extension: 45 days (we can discuss if your standard is different)
- Delivery: secure Drive link or attach to an email — we need codes by 2027-05-07 EOD
- Attendee list attached for targeted distribution (see BF_Webinar_Attendee_List.csv)

If possible, also include 50 reserve codes for speaker follow-ups / on-demand registrations. We’re happy to include Redwood in post-event comms.

Thanks — appreciate the help,
Olivia Park
Partnerships, BrightFoundry Events
Attachment: BF_Webinar_Attendee_List.csv (CSV, 2.1KB)
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: 
Date: 2027-05-04T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: 200 guest codes for ‘Sneakpeek’ partner webinar

Team — forwarding Olivia’s request. Tight turnaround (need codes by 5/7). Proposed plan below, please flag concerns:

- Allocation: 200 codes for BrightFoundry (150 standard + 50 reserved for speakers/on-demand)
- Trial profile: 45-day extended trial (promo_credit_tier: Webinar-Sneakpeek-45d)
- Delivery: send codes as a single TXT with prefix BFSPK- and store in restricted Drive link; ops to push to BrightFoundry’s secure folder
- Expiry: codes expire 60 days after issuance
- Tracking: create HubSpot deal HS-8421 and tag codes with the deal id for redemptions

Ops questions: can we generate 200 single-use codes quickly and provide a file in the requested format? Marissa — can Marketing/Legal approve the 45-day extension and the shortened SLA on code delivery? Ben — need your signoff on making exception for 50 reserve codes and to note whether this should count against our regional promo budget.

Attaching a quick sample file I pulled (promo_codes_batch_850.txt) — it's a stub for format only.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Partnerships (Sales) | Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-04T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: 200 guest codes for ‘Sneakpeek’ partner webinar

Vanessa — thanks for the heads up. Ops can generate the codes and produce both CSV and TXT formats. A few operational notes:

- Distribution recommendation: 100 auto-redeemable codes (via a vanity landing page) + 100 manual codes for targeted handouts. That reduces support overhead and fraud risk.
- Expiry: 60 days from issuance is fine; propose 45-day active trial window (as asked) but enforcement via account flags (so we don’t leave open-ended credits).
- Tracking & attribution: we'll wire codes to HubSpot deal HS-8421 and create a campaign tag BF-Sneakpeek-05-27. Please confirm whether we should assign these to the EMEA or US budget — looks like registrants are mostly US per attendee list.
- Legal/Privacy: need signoff on handing attendee CSV to partner (BrightFoundry already has the list, they asked for codes targeted by email). That’s a data-sharing touchpoint — loop in Legal if necessary.

If Ops can produce the file by EOD 5/06 we can meet BrightFoundry’s 5/07 deadline. Attaching redemption_flow_outline.pdf for the landing page flow and sample code format.

-Marissa
Director, Growth Marketing | Redwood Inference
Attachment: redemption_flow_outline.pdf (PDF, 48KB)
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-04T12:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: 200 guest codes for ‘Sneakpeek’ partner webinar

Greenlight from me — approve 200 codes (150 distributed, 50 reserved). OK to use US promo budget. Keep the redemption split as Marissa suggested.

Ben Carter
Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
